source_caption:
The Package follows a group of teenage friends who set out on a camping trip that quickly turns into a chaotic adventure after a bizarre accident leaves one of them with a serious problem. The friends must race against time to get him medical help while dealing with a series of increasingly ridiculous obstacles.

In The Package, the story combines crude humor, friendship, and misadventures as the group struggles to fix the situation before it becomes worse. Known for its outrageous premise and over-the-top comedy, the film mixes gross-out humor with heartfelt moments about loyalty and friendship.

source_details.title: The Package
source_details.synopsis: The Package is a 2012 American action film directed by Jesse V. Johnson and starring Steve Austin and Dolph Lundgren. The film was shot in Abbotsford, Langley, and Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, in twenty days from February 14 to March 5, 2012.
